part.text:
Fixed `markup/goldmark/blockquotes/blockquotes.go:258` by making the GitHub alert regex case-insensitive (`(?i)`). Alert types now match `[!note]`, `[!Note]`, `[!nOtE]`, etc., while still normalizing the returned type to lowercase.

`go test ./markup/goldmark/blockquotes/...` passes.
